channels.name: Direct browser / installable web app
gate: Publish and verify offline app independently of store listing; browser installation support varies.

channels.name: Firefox Add-ons (AMO)
gate: Mozilla account access, native extension validation and signing, store review.
channels.observed_account_gate: Official submission route opened Mozilla sign-in; no authenticated developer session was established.

channels.name: Microsoft Edge Add-ons
gate: Free developer enrollment, account verification, native extension testing and store review.

channels.name: Microsoft Store
gate: Use new free signup; owner identity verification, real app identity, PWA packaging and certification. No MSIX built.

channels.name: Google Play
gate: New account registration costs USD 25; blocked by zero-budget instruction. No payment or APK/AAB created.

channels.name: Chrome Web Store
gate: New developer account requires a registration fee; no paid signup. Unpacked candidate is not a store listing.

channels.name: Printables
gate: Free-model route only; authenticated upload, supported GPL license, matching photo and exact-asset validation.
channels.observed_account_gate: Official site opened with a Login control; no model draft was created.

channels.name: MakerWorld
gate: Official policy retrieval blocked; recheck photo, AI, license and link rules before upload. No exclusivity. Exact-asset photograph absent.
channels.policy_fetch_result: 403 on official community-guidelines route; not treated as a publication fee, and not bypassed.
